Rare Investment Opportunity in Noe Valley  Vacant 4-Plex in an Ideal Location! This charming multi-family building offers a mix of spacious units perfect for owner-occupants or investors. 
The FIRST FLOOR offers: Studio/1 Bath  Recently vacated and ready for your updates  & 1 Bedroom/1 Bath  A cozy unit with great potential.
The SECOND FLOOR offers: Studio with Den/1 Bath  Bright and nicely staged, offering versatile living space & 1 Bedroom/1 Bath - Well-sized unit with excellent natural light.

The property features a prime location in the heart of Noe Valley, known for its vibrant community, trendy shops, and excellent dining options. While there is some deferred maintenance, this property presents a fantastic opportunity to renovate and add value to maximize rental potential. Whether you're looking to live in one unit and rent out the others, or seeking a rental property with great potential, this 4-plex has the flexibility and space to meet your needs.

Don't miss your chance to secure this investment in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods!
